blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nearly 2,000 job order and contract-of-service workers at the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) will gain access to Social Security System (SSS) benefits under a new arrangement that will bring in at least P1.5 million in monthly member contributions. On Tuesday, the SSS and MMDA signed a memorandum of agreement to enroll about 1,996 JO and COS workers under the KaSSSangga Collect Program, which extends social security coverage to workers not covered by the Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) due to their employment status.
